answer: One enforceable rule: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The cedar of work and the wharf of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a pulse to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
